entries.english: to love; affection; to be fond of

mandarin.simplified: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。

cantonese.simplified: 你好快就会开始钟意佢㗎喇。
cantonese.traditional: 你好快就會開始鍾意佢㗎喇。
cantonese.english: You will soon get to like him.

mandarin.simplified: 她开朗的个性使我觉得快乐。
mandarin.traditional: 她開朗的個性使我覺得快樂。
mandarin.english: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.

cantonese.simplified: 圣诞节快乐！
cantonese.traditional: 聖誕節快樂！
cantonese.english: Merry Christmas!

entries.usage_note: Tiredness sense only; unrelated Mandarin readings/senses are excluded.

mandarin.simplified: 参观所有观光胜地累坏了我。
mandarin.traditional: 參觀所有觀光勝地累壞了我。
mandarin.english: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋唔系个个都好似你咁攰。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋唔係個個都好似你咁攰。
cantonese.english: We're not all as tired as you are.

entries.english: to leave; to part from; to be away from
source_senses: one of the Eight Trigrams 八卦

mandarin.simplified: Tom离婚了，他有个女儿。
mandarin.traditional: Tom離婚了，他有個女兒。
mandarin.english: Tom is divorced and has a daughter.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋听到隔离有嘢郁紧。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋聽到隔離有嘢鬱緊。
cantonese.english: We heard something moving in the next room.

mandarin.simplified: 一两天是没办法逛完东京的。
mandarin.traditional: 一兩天是沒辦法逛完東京的。
mandarin.english: It's impossible to do the sights of Tokyo in a day or two.

cantonese.simplified: 仲有两个礼拜就到圣诞节喇。
cantonese.traditional: 仲有兩個禮拜就到聖誕節喇。
cantonese.english: Christmas is just two weeks from now.

mandarin.simplified: 他们的小婴孩已经会走路了。
mandarin.traditional: 他們的小嬰孩已經會走路了。
mandarin.english: Their baby is able to walk already.

cantonese.simplified: 佢哋用铲清理紧行人路啲雪。
cantonese.traditional: 佢哋用鏟清理緊行人路啲雪。
cantonese.english: They were clearing the snow from the sidewalk with a shovel.

mandarin.simplified: 他旅行期间，写了旅游日记。
mandarin.traditional: 他旅行期間，寫了旅遊日記。
mandarin.english: He kept a diary during the trip.

cantonese.simplified: 「旅游」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「旅遊」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “旅遊” mean?

entries.english: to sell; to betray; to spare no effort

mandarin.simplified: 他卖掉了他的事业并且退休。
mandarin.traditional: 他賣掉了他的事業並且退休。
mandarin.english: He sold his business and retired.

cantonese.simplified: 嗰间舖头卖唔卖笔记簿㗎？
cantonese.traditional: 嗰間舖頭賣唔賣筆記簿㗎？
cantonese.english: Do they sell notebooks at that store?

mandarin.simplified: 请讲慢一点，让我们能听懂。
mandarin.traditional: 請講慢一點，讓我們能聽懂。
mandarin.english: Speak more slowly so that we can understand you.

cantonese.simplified: 个医生叫我慢慢噉深呼吸。
cantonese.traditional: 個醫生叫我慢慢噉深呼吸。
cantonese.english: The doctor told me to inhale and exhale slowly and deeply.

mandarin.simplified: 你说你有困难。我能帮忙吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你説你有困難。我能幫忙嗎？
mandarin.english: You said you were in trouble. How can I help?

cantonese.simplified: 唔好意思，我而家好忙呀。
cantonese.traditional: 唔好意思，我而家好忙呀。
cantonese.english: I'm sorry, I'm busy right now.

mandarin.simplified: 不幸的是，我必须每天早起。
mandarin.traditional: 不幸的是，我必須每天早起。
mandarin.english: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.

cantonese.simplified: 我阿妈每日晏昼都会瞓晏觉。
cantonese.traditional: 我阿媽每日晏晝都會瞓晏覺。
cantonese.english: My mother takes a nap every afternoon.

source_senses: fig. younger woman (esp. girl friend or rival)

mandarin.simplified: 他让妹妹帮他涂他房间的墙。
mandarin.traditional: 他讓妹妹幫他塗他房間的牆。
mandarin.english: He had his sister help him paint the wall of his room.

cantonese.simplified: 我有一个阿哥同一个细妹。
cantonese.traditional: 我有一個阿哥同一個細妹。
cantonese.english: I have an older brother and a younger sister.

mandarin.simplified: 亚美尼亚语是一门印欧语言。
mandarin.traditional: 亞美尼亞語是一門印歐語言。
mandarin.english: Armenian is an Indo-European language.

cantonese.simplified: 你可唔可以唔好开住道门呀？
cantonese.traditional: 你可唔可以唔好開住道門呀？
cantonese.english: Would you please not leave the door open?

mandarin.simplified: 你在车站遇到的男人是我爸。
mandarin.traditional: 你在車站遇到的男人是我爸。
mandarin.english: The man you met at the station is my father.

cantonese.simplified: 有个男人开门走咗出嚟。
cantonese.traditional: 有個男人開門走咗出嚟。
cantonese.english: The door opened and a man came out.

mandarin.simplified: 在您国家的人是吃米饭的吗？
mandarin.traditional: 在您國家的人是吃米飯的嗎？
mandarin.english: Do people in your country eat rice?

cantonese.simplified: 「您」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「您」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “您” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 奶油和乳酪是由牛奶做成的。
mandarin.traditional: 奶油和乳酪是由牛奶做成的。
mandarin.english: Butter and cheese are made from milk.

cantonese.simplified: 我钟意饮牛奶多过饮果汁。
cantonese.traditional: 我鍾意飲牛奶多過飲果汁。
cantonese.english: I prefer milk to juice.

mandarin.simplified: 我看见一个穿黑衣服的女人。
mandarin.traditional: 我看見一個穿黑衣服的女人。
mandarin.english: I saw a woman in black.

cantonese.simplified: 警察喺个女人度问唔到任何嘢。
cantonese.traditional: 警察喺個女人度問唔到任何嘢。
cantonese.english: The police were unable to get anything out of the woman.

mandarin.simplified: 一个美丽的女孩坐在我旁边。
mandarin.traditional: 一個美麗的女孩坐在我旁邊。
mandarin.english: A beautiful girl sat next to me.

cantonese.simplified: 如果你喺我隔篱就好喇。
cantonese.traditional: 如果你喺我隔籬就好喇。
cantonese.english: I wish you were with me.

entries.english: to walk quickly; to march; to run

mandarin.simplified: 他每天都在公园中跑步。
mandarin.traditional: 他每天都在公園中跑步。
mandarin.english: He runs in the park every day.

cantonese.simplified: 佢惯咗食早餐之前会去跑步。
cantonese.traditional: 佢慣咗食早餐之前會去跑步。
cantonese.english: She is in the habit of jogging before breakfast.

mandarin.simplified: 九点以后打电话比较便宜吗？
mandarin.traditional: 九點以後打電話比較便宜嗎？
mandarin.english: Is it cheaper to call after 9:00?

cantonese.simplified: 有得代客泊车嘅餐厅都唔慌平。
cantonese.traditional: 有得代客泊車嘅餐廳都唔慌平。
cantonese.english: If a restaurant has valet parking it's probably pretty expensive.

source_senses: classifier for shipments and business transactions (topolect)

mandarin.simplified: 他的兴趣爱好是收集旧邮票。
mandarin.traditional: 他的興趣愛好是收集舊郵票。
mandarin.english: His hobby is collecting old stamps.

cantonese.simplified: 我唔记得咗黐张邮票落个信封到。
cantonese.traditional: 我唔記得咗黐張郵票落個信封到。
cantonese.english: I forgot to stick a stamp on the envelope.

mandarin.simplified: 他失信了，这让他妻子生气。
mandarin.traditional: 他失信了，這讓他妻子生氣。
mandarin.english: He broke his word, which made his wife angry.

cantonese.simplified: 佢成日都送礼物俾老婆。
cantonese.traditional: 佢成日都送禮物俾老婆。
cantonese.english: He is always giving presents to his wife.

mandarin.simplified: 他像往常一样五点钟起床。
mandarin.traditional: 他像往常一樣五點鐘起牀。
mandarin.english: He got up at five as usual.

cantonese.simplified: 点解阿Tom唔叫我起身嘅？
cantonese.traditional: 點解阿Tom唔叫我起身嘅？
cantonese.english: Why didn't Tom wake me up?

mandarin.simplified: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。
mandarin.traditional: 成千上萬的人想要知道答案。
mandarin.english: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.

cantonese.simplified: 场音乐会有三千几人去咗听。
cantonese.traditional: 場音樂會有三千幾人去咗聽。
cantonese.english: More than 3,000 people were at the concert.

mandarin.simplified: 根据气象预报，明天会是晴天。
mandarin.traditional: 根據氣象預報，明天會是晴天。
mandarin.english: The weather forecast says it will be fine tomorrow.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋想知听日会唔会晴天。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋想知聽日會唔會晴天。
cantonese.english: We want to know if it'll be sunny tomorrow.

mandarin.simplified: 去年他在海上度过了三个月。
mandarin.traditional: 去年他在海上度過了三個月。
mandarin.english: Last year, he spent three months at sea.

cantonese.simplified: 你旧年收到几多张圣诞卡呀？
cantonese.traditional: 你舊年收到幾多張聖誕卡呀？
cantonese.english: How many Christmas cards did you get last year?

entries.english: to yield; to permit; to let sb do sth

mandarin.simplified: 不要做任何会让你后悔的事。
mandarin.traditional: 不要做任何會讓你後悔的事。
mandarin.english: Don't do anything you'll regret.

cantonese.simplified: 佢让咗个位俾个老人家。
cantonese.traditional: 佢讓咗個位俾個老人家。
cantonese.english: He gave his seat to the old man.

mandarin.simplified: 我和她的男朋友在一起上班。
mandarin.traditional: 我和她的男朋友在一起上班。
mandarin.english: I work with her boyfriend.

cantonese.simplified: 我听日要返工。
cantonese.traditional: 我聽日要返工。
cantonese.english: I have to go to work tomorrow.

mandarin.simplified: 我泡了个澡身体暖和起来了。
mandarin.traditional: 我泡了個澡身體暖和起來了。
mandarin.english: I warmed myself in the bath.

cantonese.simplified: 咪嗍胶水啦，整坏身体啊！
cantonese.traditional: 咪嗍膠水啦，整壞身體啊！
cantonese.english: Don't sniff glue. It's bad for you.

mandarin.simplified: 他从上周日开始就生病了。
mandarin.traditional: 他從上週日開始就生病了。
mandarin.english: He has been sick since last Sunday.

cantonese.simplified: 「生病」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「生病」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “生病” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 他在医院里过了六十岁生日。
mandarin.traditional: 他在醫院裡過了六十歲生日。
mandarin.english: He spent his sixtieth birthday in the hospital.

cantonese.simplified: 佢送咗只表俾我做生日礼物。
cantonese.traditional: 佢送咗隻錶俾我做生日禮物。
cantonese.english: She gave me a watch for a birthday present.

mandarin.simplified: 他们到达的确切时间还不明。
mandarin.traditional: 他們到達的確切時間還不明。
mandarin.english: The precise time of their arrival is not known.

cantonese.simplified: 如果我哋有多啲时间咪好啰。
cantonese.traditional: 如果我哋有多啲時間咪好囉。
cantonese.english: I wish we had more time.

mandarin.simplified: 我没有其他更好的事情去做。
mandarin.traditional: 我沒有其他更好的事情去做。
mandarin.english: I have nothing better to do.

cantonese.simplified: 「事情」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「事情」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “事情” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我花了五十美元修好了手表。
mandarin.traditional: 我花了五十美元修好了手表。
mandarin.english: It cost me 50 dollars to have my watch fixed.

cantonese.simplified: 「手表」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「手錶」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “手錶” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我今天早上跟Tom借手机。
mandarin.traditional: 我今天早上跟Tom藉手機。
mandarin.english: I borrowed Tom's phone this morning.

cantonese.simplified: 「手机」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「手機」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “手機” mean?

entries.english: to deliver; to carry; to give (as a present)

mandarin.simplified: 你们想送汤姆什么圣诞礼物？
mandarin.traditional: 你們想送湯姆什麼聖誕禮物？
mandarin.english: What do you want to get Tom for Christmas?

cantonese.simplified: 佢应承咗话会送只戒指俾我。
cantonese.traditional: 佢應承咗話會送隻戒指俾我。
cantonese.english: She's promised to give me a ring.

mandarin.simplified: 他病了，所以脸色显得苍白。
mandarin.traditional: 他病了，所以臉色顯得蒼白。
mandarin.english: He's pale because he's sick.

cantonese.simplified: 冇人请佢去，所以佢好失望。
cantonese.traditional: 冇人請佢去，所以佢好失望。
cantonese.english: He was disappointed at not being invited.

entries.usage_note: Spoken pronoun for an animal or thing; context supplies the referent.

mandarin.simplified: 为什么它应该要变得不一样？
mandarin.traditional: 為什麼它應該要變得不一樣？
mandarin.english: Why should it be different?

cantonese.simplified: 「咪嘈啦！」佢细细声噉讲。
cantonese.traditional: 「咪嘈啦！」佢細細聲噉講。
cantonese.english: "Shut up," he whispered.

mandarin.simplified: 我们放学后会去踢足球。
mandarin.traditional: 我們放學後會去踢足球。
mandarin.english: We will play soccer after school.

cantonese.simplified: 佢唔读书，所以就俾人踢咗出校。
cantonese.traditional: 佢唔讀書，所以就俾人踢咗出校。
cantonese.english: They booted him out of school for not studying.

entries.english: topic; problem for discussion; exam question

mandarin.simplified: 交通是都市的一个主要问题。
mandarin.traditional: 交通是都市的一個主要問題。
mandarin.english: Traffic is a major urban problem.

cantonese.simplified: 呢个系一个非常复杂嘅问题。
cantonese.traditional: 呢個係一個非常複雜嘅問題。
cantonese.english: This is a very complex problem.

mandarin.simplified: 我的女朋友跳舞跳得很棒。
mandarin.traditional: 我的女朋友跳舞跳得很棒。
mandarin.english: My girlfriend is a good dancer.

cantonese.simplified: 希望冇人见到我跳舞啦。
cantonese.traditional: 希望冇人見到我跳舞啦。
cantonese.english: I hope no one saw me dancing.

mandarin.simplified: 不要害怕意外，但要有准备。
mandarin.traditional: 不要害怕意外，但要有準備。
mandarin.english: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.

cantonese.simplified: 我同个外国学生做咗好朋友。
cantonese.traditional: 我同個外國學生做咗好朋友。
cantonese.english: I made friends with a student from abroad.

entries.english: to finish; to be over; whole

mandarin.simplified: 一两天是没办法逛完东京的。
mandarin.traditional: 一兩天是沒辦法逛完東京的。
mandarin.english: It's impossible to do the sights of Tokyo in a day or two.

cantonese.simplified: 你后日一定要做完呢份功课。
cantonese.traditional: 你後日一定要做完呢份功課。
cantonese.english: You must get this homework finished by the day after tomorrow.

entries.english: toy; sth used for amusement; curio or antique (Taiwan pr. )

mandarin.simplified: 他一个月玩两到三次高尔夫。
mandarin.traditional: 他一個月玩兩到三次高爾夫。
mandarin.english: He plays golf two or three times a month.

cantonese.simplified: 今个夏天你谂住去边度玩呀？
cantonese.traditional: 今個夏天你諗住去邊度玩呀？
cantonese.english: Where do you want to go this summer?

mandarin.simplified: 你听了我昨天晚上的节目吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你聽了我昨天晚上的節目嗎？
mandarin.english: Did you hear my show last night?

cantonese.simplified: 我带啲嘢俾Tom食夜晚。
cantonese.traditional: 我帶啲嘢俾Tom食夜晚。
cantonese.english: I'm going to bring Tom some dinner.

entries.english: variant of 為|为; because of; for

mandarin.simplified: 不是每个人都想成为艺术家。
mandarin.traditional: 不是每個人都想成為藝術家。
mandarin.english: Not everybody wants to be an artist.

cantonese.simplified: 佢好失望，因为冇人请佢去。
cantonese.traditional: 佢好失望，因為冇人請佢去。
cantonese.english: He was disappointed at not being invited.

mandarin.simplified: 不好意思，请问鸡蛋在哪儿？
mandarin.traditional: 不好意思，請問雞蛋在哪兒？
mandarin.english: Excuse me. Where are the eggs?

cantonese.simplified: 呢个系一个非常复杂嘅问题。
cantonese.traditional: 呢個係一個非常複雜嘅問題。
cantonese.english: This is a very complex problem.

mandarin.simplified: 交通是都市的一个主要问题。
mandarin.traditional: 交通是都市的一個主要問題。
mandarin.english: Traffic is a major urban problem.

cantonese.simplified: 呢个系一个非常复杂嘅问题。
cantonese.traditional: 呢個係一個非常複雜嘅問題。
cantonese.english: This is a very complex problem.

mandarin.simplified: 我们还没吃完这个西瓜。
mandarin.traditional: 我們還沒吃完這個西瓜。
mandarin.english: We haven't finished eating the watermelon yet.

cantonese.simplified: 我好钟意食西瓜。
cantonese.traditional: 我好鍾意食西瓜。
cantonese.english: I like to eat watermelon.

mandarin.simplified: 我希望我能说法语说得更好。
mandarin.traditional: 我希望我能説法語説得更好。
mandarin.english: I wish that I could speak French better.

cantonese.simplified: 希望你讲嘅嘢唔系真㗎啦。
cantonese.traditional: 希望你講嘅嘢唔係真㗎啦。
cantonese.english: I wish you were wrong.

entries.english: to wash; to bathe; to develop (photo)

mandarin.simplified: 在我洗澡的时候，电话响了。
mandarin.traditional: 在我洗澡的時候，電話響了。
mandarin.english: I was in the bath when the phone rang.

cantonese.simplified: 你仲未洗手㖞，系唔系呀？
cantonese.traditional: 你仲未洗手喎，係唔係呀？
cantonese.english: You haven't washed your hands yet, have you?

entries.english: towards; to face; to turn towards

mandarin.simplified: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。
mandarin.traditional: 他匿名向紅十字捐了大筆錢。
mandarin.english: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.

cantonese.simplified: 个骑士发誓向国王忠诚。
cantonese.traditional: 個騎士發誓向國王忠誠。
cantonese.english: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.

mandarin.simplified: 他们已经在这里一个小时了。
mandarin.traditional: 他們已經在這裡一個小時了。
mandarin.english: They have been here for an hour.

cantonese.simplified: 「小时」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「小時」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “小時” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 为甚么他不再跟我讲笑话了？
mandarin.traditional: 為甚麼他不再跟我講笑話了？

mandarin.simplified: 他总是把他的房间保持干净。
mandarin.traditional: 他總是把他的房間保持乾淨。
mandarin.english: He always keeps his room clean.

cantonese.traditional: 我哋喺巴士總站度撞到佢哋。
cantonese.english: We ran into them at the bus terminal.

mandarin.simplified: 不要做任何会让你后悔的事。
mandarin.traditional: 不要做任何會讓你後悔的事。
mandarin.english: Don't do anything you'll regret.

cantonese.simplified: 佢唔肯讲任何关于自己嘅嘢。
cantonese.traditional: 佢唔肯講任何關於自己嘅嘢。
cantonese.english: He won't say anything about himself.

mandarin.traditional: “電話響了。”“我去接。”

cantonese.traditional: 「電話響喎。」「我聽吖。」
cantonese.english: "The phone is ringing." "I'll get it."

mandarin.simplified: 4在日本是一个不幸的数字。
mandarin.traditional: 4在日本是一個不幸的數字。
mandarin.english: Four is an unlucky number in Japan.

cantonese.traditional: 張枱上面嗰部計數機係我嘅。
cantonese.english: The calculator on the table is mine.

mandarin.traditional: 一旦過了河, 你就安全了。
mandarin.english: Once you cross the river, you'll be safe.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋要揾一个安全嘅地方匿埋。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋要揾一個安全嘅地方匿埋。
cantonese.english: We need to find a safe place to hide.

mandarin.simplified: 东京巨蛋的电话号码是多少？

mandarin.english: What's the number for the Tokyo Dome?

cantonese.simplified: 我净系想要少少私人时间啫。
cantonese.traditional: 我淨係想要少少私人時間啫。
cantonese.english: I just need some time alone.

mandarin.simplified: 他这个月还没有提交报告书。
mandarin.traditional: 他這個月還沒有提交報告書。
mandarin.english: He hasn't yet turned in the report this month.

cantonese.simplified: 今日份报纸无咩值得睇嘅新闻。
cantonese.traditional: 今日份報紙無咩值得睇嘅新聞。
cantonese.english: Today's paper contains nothing of importance.

mandarin.simplified: 他是个富有才能的年轻导演。
mandarin.traditional: 他是個富有才能的年輕導演。
mandarin.english: He's a talented young director.

cantonese.simplified: 爱因斯坦系一个数学天才。
cantonese.traditional: 愛因斯坦係一個數學天才。
cantonese.english: Einstein was a mathematical genius.

mandarin.simplified: 他迫不及待地想要知道结果。
mandarin.traditional: 他迫不及待地想要知道結果。
mandarin.english: He is anxious to know the result.

cantonese.simplified: 佢哋好似对个结果好满意噉。
cantonese.traditional: 佢哋好似對個結果好滿意噉。
cantonese.english: It looks like they're satisfied with the result.

mandarin.simplified: 他在心里反复思量这件事。
mandarin.traditional: 他在心裏反覆思量這件事。

cantonese.simplified: 我唔觉得自己好大反应啰。
cantonese.traditional: 我唔覺得自己好大反應囉。
cantonese.english: I don't think I overreacted.

mandarin.simplified: 今晚我非常享受和你的聊天。
mandarin.traditional: 今晚我非常享受和你的聊天。
mandarin.english: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.

cantonese.simplified: 葡萄酒嘅味道好受天气影响。
cantonese.traditional: 葡萄酒嘅味道好受天氣影響。
cantonese.english: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.

mandarin.english: The end justifies the means.

cantonese.traditional: 你係我識嘅人入面最醒目嗰個。

mandarin.traditional: “你説得太多了，”他説道。

cantonese.traditional: 全靠你，我哋先做得切咋。

mandarin.simplified: 他在医院里过了六十岁生日。

cantonese.simplified: 你可唔可以车我去医院呀？

mandarin.traditional: 不要做任何會讓你後悔的事。

cantonese.traditional: 佢讓咗個位俾個老人家。

mandarin.traditional: 什麼時候對你來説是方便的？

cantonese.simplified: 佢系其中一个市长嘅候选人。
cantonese.traditional: 佢係其中一個市長嘅候選人。
cantonese.english: He is one of the candidates running for mayor.

cantonese.traditional: 我帶啲嘢食俾Tom做晚餐。

cantonese.simplified: 「导」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「導」即係咩意思？

mandarin.traditional: 和他爭論這件事得不出結果。
mandarin.english: It is no use arguing with him about it.

cantonese.simplified: 同法国嘅战争已经结束。

mandarin.simplified: 他曾是个英式橄榄球运动员。
mandarin.traditional: 他曾是個英式橄欖球運動員。

cantonese.simplified: 「运」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「運」即係咩意思？

mandarin.simplified: 为甚么他不再跟我讲笑话了？
mandarin.traditional: 為甚麼他不再跟我講笑話了？

mandarin.traditional: 她上飛機前，給我招了招手。
mandarin.english: She waved at me before she got on board the plane.

cantonese.simplified: 我可唔可以睇一睇你张飞呀？
cantonese.traditional: 我可唔可以睇一睇你張飛呀？
cantonese.english: May I have a look at your ticket?

mandarin.simplified: 今天许多学校因为风暴停课。
mandarin.traditional: 今天許多學校因為風暴停課。

cantonese.simplified: 嗰度啲风景真系靓到唔知点形容。
cantonese.traditional: 嗰度啲風景真係靚到唔知點形容。
cantonese.english: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.

mandarin.simplified: 我们不知道下一步要做什么。
mandarin.traditional: 我們不知道下一步要做什麼。

cantonese.traditional: 我哋冇收到通知話佢哋改咗地址。

mandarin.english: He heard the news on the radio.

cantonese.traditional: 你舊年收到幾多張聖誕卡呀？
cantonese.english: How many Christmas cards did you get last year?

mandarin.simplified: 不要根据封面来判断一本书。
mandarin.traditional: 不要根據封面來判斷一本書。
mandarin.english: Don't judge a book by its cover.

mandarin.simplified: 他总是把他的房间保持干净。
mandarin.traditional: 他總是把他的房間保持乾淨。

cantonese.simplified: 佢去咗名古屋公干。
cantonese.traditional: 佢去咗名古屋公幹。

mandarin.traditional: 他買土地的目的是要造房子。
mandarin.english: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.

cantonese.simplified: 呢部电视系中国制造嘅。
cantonese.traditional: 呢部電視係中國製造嘅。

cantonese.traditional: 我哋組輸咗第一回合。
cantonese.english: Our team lost the first game.

mandarin.traditional: 不幸的是，我必須每天早起。
mandarin.english: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.

cantonese.traditional: 我阿媽每日晏晝都會瞓晏覺。
cantonese.english: My mother takes a nap every afternoon.

mandarin.english: Your name has been crossed off the list.

cantonese.simplified: 我用咗一千円修理我架单车。
cantonese.traditional: 我用咗一千円修理我架單車。
cantonese.english: It cost me a thousand yen to get my bicycle fixed.

mandarin.simplified: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。
mandarin.traditional: 他在醫學界有很大的影響力。
mandarin.english: He's very influential in the world of medicine.

cantonese.simplified: 葡萄酒嘅味道好受天气影响。
cantonese.traditional: 葡萄酒嘅味道好受天氣影響。
cantonese.english: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.

mandarin.simplified: 一些家具是用胶水黏在一起。
mandarin.traditional: 一些傢俱是用膠水黏在一起。
mandarin.english: Some furniture is put together with glue.

cantonese.simplified: 「具」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「具」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “具” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我在找关于古罗马历史的书。
mandarin.traditional: 我在找關於古羅馬歷史的書。
mandarin.english: I'm looking for books on Roman history.

cantonese.simplified: 我喺度揾紧啲讲古罗马历史嘅书。
cantonese.traditional: 我喺度揾緊啲講古羅馬歷史嘅書。
cantonese.english: I'm looking for books on Roman history.

mandarin.simplified: 4在日本是一个不幸的数字。
mandarin.traditional: 4在日本是一個不幸的數字。
mandarin.english: Four is an unlucky number in Japan.

cantonese.simplified: 你可以随时攞我本字典去用。
cantonese.traditional: 你可以隨時攞我本字典去用。
cantonese.english: You may always use my dictionary.

mandarin.simplified: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。
mandarin.traditional: 不要把慾望和愛情混為一談。
mandarin.english: Don't confuse desire with love.

cantonese.simplified: 你嗰阵话你爱我系咪呃我㗎？
cantonese.traditional: 你嗰陣話你愛我係咪呃我㗎？
cantonese.english: Was it a lie when you said you loved me?

mandarin.simplified: 一连串的灾难袭击这个地区。
mandarin.traditional: 一連串的災難襲擊這個地區。
mandarin.english: A string of disasters struck the region.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋俾成班蜜蜂攻击。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋俾成班蜜蜂攻擊。
cantonese.english: We were attacked by swarms of bees.

mandarin.simplified: 他们建了一座横跨河流的桥。
mandarin.traditional: 他們建了一座橫跨河流的橋。
mandarin.english: They built a bridge across the river.

cantonese.simplified: 我听到佢讲英文讲到好似美国人咁流利。
cantonese.traditional: 我聽到佢講英文講到好似美國人咁流利。
cantonese.english: I heard her speaking English as fluently as an American.

mandarin.simplified: 不要害怕意外，但要有准备。
mandarin.traditional: 不要害怕意外，但要有準備。
mandarin.english: Do not fear the unexpected, but be prepared for it.

cantonese.simplified: 你应该要准备间房畀访客。
cantonese.traditional: 你應該要準備間房畀訪客。
cantonese.english: You should prepare a room for the visitor.

mandarin.simplified: 很快，城市就被士兵占领了。
mandarin.traditional: 很快，城市就被士兵佔領了。
mandarin.english: The city was soon occupied by the soldiers.

cantonese.simplified: 「兵」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「兵」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “兵” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 一连串的灾难袭击这个地区。
mandarin.traditional: 一連串的災難襲擊這個地區。
mandarin.english: A string of disasters struck the region.

cantonese.simplified: 呢到连冬天都唔系落好多雪。
cantonese.traditional: 呢到連冬天都唔係落好多雪。
cantonese.english: We don't have much snow here even in the winter.

mandarin.simplified: 他宣布他将立刻来调查此事。
mandarin.traditional: 他宣佈他將立刻來調查此事。
mandarin.english: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.

cantonese.simplified: 调查呢件事件最少要三个礼拜。
cantonese.traditional: 調查呢件事件最少要三個禮拜。
cantonese.english: To investigate the incident would take us at least three weeks.

mandarin.simplified: 患者现在处于深度昏迷状态。
mandarin.traditional: 患者現在處於深度昏迷狀態。
mandarin.english: The patient is in a deep coma.

cantonese.simplified: 个医生叫我慢慢噉深呼吸。
cantonese.traditional: 個醫生叫我慢慢噉深呼吸。
cantonese.english: The doctor told me to inhale and exhale slowly and deeply.

mandarin.simplified: 你知道商场什么时候关门吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你知道商場什麼時候關門嗎？
mandarin.english: Do you know when the supermarket closes?

cantonese.simplified: 「商」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「商」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “商” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我们打算让你知道这个秘密。
mandarin.traditional: 我們打算讓你知道這個秘密。
mandarin.english: We intended to let you in on the secret.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋荡失路，唔知点算好。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋蕩失路，唔知點算好。
cantonese.english: We lost our way and did not know what to do.

mandarin.simplified: 他们的货品有着最高的品质。
mandarin.traditional: 他們的貨品有着最高的品質。
mandarin.english: Their goods are of the highest quality.

cantonese.simplified: 你会唔会觉得我份人太过物质呀？
cantonese.traditional: 你會唔會覺得我份人太過物質呀？
cantonese.english: Do you think I'm too materialistic?

mandarin.simplified: 我觉得我们团队会继续变好。
mandarin.traditional: 我覺得我們團隊會繼續變好。
mandarin.english: I think our team is going to continue to get better.

cantonese.simplified: 荷李活啲电影多数都系大团圆结局。
cantonese.traditional: 荷李活啲電影多數都係大團圓結局。
cantonese.english: Most Hollywood movies have a happy ending.

mandarin.simplified: 他的兴趣爱好是收集旧邮票。
mandarin.traditional: 他的興趣愛好是收集舊郵票。
mandarin.english: His hobby is collecting old stamps.

cantonese.simplified: 我要集中精神做嘢。
cantonese.traditional: 我要集中精神做嘢。
cantonese.english: I have to concentrate on my work.

mandarin.simplified: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。
mandarin.traditional: 他有超過一百萬美元的資產。
mandarin.english: He has over a million dollars in assets.

cantonese.simplified: 一碗饭大约一百八十克咁重。
cantonese.traditional: 一碗飯大約一百八十克咁重。
cantonese.english: A bowl of rice is about 180 grams.

mandarin.simplified: 为什么他们会需要那么做呢？
mandarin.traditional: 為什麼他們會需要那麼做呢？
mandarin.english: Why would they need to do that?

cantonese.simplified: 你唔需要觉得自己比唔上人。
cantonese.traditional: 你唔需要覺得自己比唔上人。
cantonese.english: There is no reason for you to feel inferior to anyone.

mandarin.simplified: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
mandarin.traditional: 我們應該不惜代價避免戰爭。
mandarin.english: We must avoid war at all cost.

cantonese.simplified: 我买咗呢件减紧价嘅 T 恤。
cantonese.traditional: 我買咗呢件減緊價嘅 T 恤。
cantonese.english: I bought this T-shirt on sale.

mandarin.simplified: 他们不会允许我们进花园的。
mandarin.traditional: 他們不會允許我們進花園的。
mandarin.english: They won't allow us to enter the garden.

cantonese.simplified: 个花樽里面啲花系玫瑰嚟嘅。
cantonese.traditional: 個花樽裏面啲花係玫瑰嚟嘅。
cantonese.english: The flowers in the vase are roses.

mandarin.simplified: 总理的发言估计激怒了在野党。
mandarin.traditional: 總理的發言估計激怒了在野黨。
mandarin.english: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.

cantonese.simplified: 「党」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「黨」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “黨” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 汤姆是个很有才华的作家。
mandarin.traditional: 湯姆是個很有才華的作家。
mandarin.english: Tom is a very talented writer.

cantonese.simplified: 佢唔单止靓女，仲好有才华添。
cantonese.traditional: 佢唔單止靚女，仲好有才華添。
cantonese.english: She was not merely beautiful, but also talented.

mandarin.simplified: 凤凰城是亚利桑那州的首府。
mandarin.traditional: 鳳凰城是亞利桑那州的首府。
mandarin.english: Phoenix is the capital of Arizona.

cantonese.simplified: 佢系成座城最有钱嗰个。
cantonese.traditional: 佢係成座城最有錢嗰個。
cantonese.english: He is richer than anyone else in the town.

mandarin.simplified: “滚石不生苔”是一句谚语。
mandarin.traditional: “滾石不生苔”是一句諺語。
mandarin.english: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

cantonese.simplified: 佢抌咗块石头落个池度。
cantonese.traditional: 佢抌咗塊石頭落個池度。
cantonese.english: He threw a rock into the pond.

mandarin.simplified: 羽衣甘蓝被认为是超级食物。
mandarin.traditional: 羽衣甘藍被認為是超級食物。
mandarin.english: Kale is considered a superfood.

cantonese.simplified: 佢喺超级市场度买咗部吸尘机。
cantonese.traditional: 佢喺超級市場度買咗部吸塵機。
cantonese.english: She bought a vacuum cleaner at the supermarket.

mandarin.simplified: 我不得不一整天都呆在床上。
mandarin.traditional: 我不得不一整天都呆在牀上。
mandarin.english: I had to stay in bed all day.

cantonese.simplified: 你咁样衰，整容都冇用㗎喇。
cantonese.traditional: 你咁樣衰，整容都冇用㗎喇。
cantonese.english: Even plastic surgery won't do anything for your ugliness.

mandarin.simplified: 凤凰城是亚利桑那州的首府。
mandarin.traditional: 鳳凰城是亞利桑那州的首府。
mandarin.english: Phoenix is the capital of Arizona.

cantonese.simplified: 佢哋选出咗新政府。
cantonese.traditional: 佢哋選出咗新政府。
cantonese.english: They have elected a new government.

mandarin.simplified: Tom离婚了，他有个女儿。
mandarin.traditional: Tom離婚了，他有個女兒。
mandarin.english: Tom is divorced and has a daughter.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋听到隔离有嘢郁紧。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋聽到隔離有嘢鬱緊。
cantonese.english: We heard something moving in the next room.

mandarin.simplified: 在紧急情况下，打电话报警。
mandarin.traditional: 在緊急情況下，打電話報警。
mandarin.english: In case of emergency, call the police.

cantonese.simplified: 嗰度情况好危急。
cantonese.traditional: 嗰度情況好危急。
cantonese.english: The situation there was critical.

mandarin.simplified: 亚美尼亚是一个多山的国家。
mandarin.traditional: 亞美尼亞是一個多山的國家。
mandarin.english: Armenia is a mountainous country.

cantonese.simplified: 中国系亚洲最大嘅国家。
cantonese.traditional: 中國係亞洲最大嘅國家。
cantonese.english: China is the largest country in Asia.

mandarin.simplified: 不好意思，请问鸡蛋在哪儿？
mandarin.traditional: 不好意思，請問雞蛋在哪兒？
mandarin.english: Excuse me. Where are the eggs?

cantonese.simplified: 佢好失望，因为冇人请佢去。
cantonese.traditional: 佢好失望，因為冇人請佢去。
cantonese.english: He was disappointed at not being invited.

mandarin.simplified: 这名技师组装了这台引擎。
mandarin.traditional: 這名技師組裝了這台引擎。
mandarin.english: The mechanic assembled the engine.

cantonese.simplified: 佢啲驾驶技术好差，但系都勉强通过咗个驾驶考试。
cantonese.traditional: 佢啲駕駛技術好差，但係都勉強通過咗個駕駛考試。
cantonese.english: He managed to pass his driving test even though he was a poor driver.

mandarin.simplified: 他看起来比他的实际年龄大。
mandarin.traditional: 他看起來比他的實際年齡大。
mandarin.english: He looks old for his age.

cantonese.simplified: 「际」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「際」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “際” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 人类大约有 60% 是水。
mandarin.traditional: 人類大約有 60% 是水。
mandarin.english: Human beings are about 60% water.

cantonese.simplified: 一碗饭大约一百八十克咁重。
cantonese.traditional: 一碗飯大約一百八十克咁重。
cantonese.english: A bowl of rice is about 180 grams.

mandarin.simplified: 他们没有人了解她暗示什么。
mandarin.traditional: 他們沒有人瞭解她暗示什麼。
mandarin.english: None of them could understand what she was implying.

cantonese.simplified: 「示」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「示」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “示” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我为她重复念这个字很多遍。
mandarin.traditional: 我為她重複唸這個字很多遍。
mandarin.english: I repeated the word several times for her.

cantonese.simplified: 「复」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「復」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “復” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 他病了，所以脸色显得苍白。
mandarin.traditional: 他病了，所以臉色顯得蒼白。
mandarin.english: He's pale because he's sick.

cantonese.simplified: 个医生开咗啲药俾个病人。
cantonese.traditional: 個醫生開咗啲藥俾個病人。
cantonese.english: The doctor prescribed medicine for the patient.

entries.english: rest, put stop to, end, cease

mandarin.simplified: 为什么不让你的嘴巴休息呢？
mandarin.traditional: 為什麼不讓你的嘴巴休息呢？
mandarin.english: Why don't you give your mouth a rest?

cantonese.simplified: 寻晚单消息终于传到我度。
cantonese.traditional: 尋晚單消息終於傳到我度。
cantonese.english: The news finally reached me last night.

mandarin.simplified: 我们研究了政府的经济政策。
mandarin.traditional: 我們研究了政府的經濟政策。
mandarin.english: We studied the government's economic policy.

cantonese.simplified: 佢究竟匿埋咗喺边呢？
cantonese.traditional: 佢究竟匿埋咗喺邊呢？
cantonese.english: I wonder where he is hiding.

mandarin.simplified: 哪个更好，红线呢还是白线？
mandarin.traditional: 哪個更好，紅線呢還是白線？
mandarin.english: Which is better, red thread or white thread?

cantonese.simplified: 你掂嗰条电线就会触电㗎喇。
cantonese.traditional: 你掂嗰條電線就會觸電㗎喇。
cantonese.english: If you touch that wire, you will receive a shock.

entries.english: resemble, similar to; as if, seem

mandarin.simplified: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。
mandarin.traditional: 事故似乎和厚厚的積雪有關。
mandarin.english: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.

cantonese.simplified: 佢个样好似几日冇食过嘢噉。
cantonese.traditional: 佢個樣好似幾日冇食過嘢噉。
cantonese.english: She looked as if she hadn't eaten in days.

mandarin.simplified: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。
mandarin.traditional: 他是美國大使館的外交官。
mandarin.english: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.

cantonese.simplified: 个法官判咗佢坐一年监。
cantonese.traditional: 個法官判咗佢坐一年監。
cantonese.english: The judge sentenced him to one year's imprisonment.

mandarin.simplified: 今天早上我在火车上偶遇他。
mandarin.traditional: 今天早上我在火車上偶遇他。
mandarin.english: I met him by chance on the train this morning.

cantonese.simplified: 你瞓觉之前最好整熄啲火先。
cantonese.traditional: 你瞓覺之前最好整熄啲火先。
cantonese.english: You had better put out the fire before you go to bed.

mandarin.simplified: 一位老人打断了我们的谈话。
mandarin.traditional: 一位老人打斷了我們的談話。
mandarin.english: An old man broke into our conversation.

cantonese.simplified: 断估阿Tom应该仲喺屋企。
cantonese.traditional: 斷估阿Tom應該仲喺屋企。
cantonese.english: Tom is probably still at home.

mandarin.simplified: 我能闻到他呼吸中的酒精味。
mandarin.traditional: 我能聞到他呼吸中的酒精味。
mandarin.english: I could smell the alcohol on his breath.

cantonese.simplified: 东欧嘅酒精消耗量高过西欧。
cantonese.traditional: 東歐嘅酒精消耗量高過西歐。
cantonese.english: Alcohol consumption is higher in Eastern Europe than in Western Europe.

mandarin.simplified: 他对自己的劳动成果很满意。
mandarin.traditional: 他對自己的勞動成果很滿意。
mandarin.english: He was satisfied with the work he had done.

cantonese.simplified: 佢哋好似对个结果好满意噉。
cantonese.traditional: 佢哋好似對個結果好滿意噉。
cantonese.english: It looks like they're satisfied with the result.

mandarin.simplified: 大部分美国人支持这项决定。
mandarin.traditional: 大部分美國人支持這項決定。
mandarin.english: Most Americans supported the decision.

cantonese.simplified: 可唔可以俾多支啤酒我呀？
cantonese.traditional: 可唔可以俾多支啤酒我呀？
cantonese.english: Could I get one more beer, please?

mandarin.simplified: 他喜欢看电视上的棒球比赛。
mandarin.traditional: 他喜歡看電視上的棒球比賽。
mandarin.english: He likes to watch baseball games on TV.

cantonese.simplified: 佢好钟意喺电视度睇网球比赛。
cantonese.traditional: 佢好鍾意喺電視度睇網球比賽。
cantonese.english: She loves watching tennis matches on TV.

mandarin.simplified: 他从收音机听到了这个消息。
mandarin.traditional: 他從收音機聽到了這個消息。
mandarin.english: He heard the news on the radio.

cantonese.simplified: 佢喺最后一刻取消咗个会面。
cantonese.traditional: 佢喺最後一刻取消咗個會面。
cantonese.english: He canceled the appointment at the last moment.

mandarin.simplified: 我们能看到越来越多的燕子。
mandarin.traditional: 我們能看到越來越多的燕子。
mandarin.english: We can see more and more swallows.

cantonese.simplified: 佢啲中文越嚟越好。
cantonese.traditional: 佢啲中文越嚟越好。
cantonese.english: She is progressing in Chinese.

mandarin.simplified: 汤姆试著用灭火器把火扑灭。
mandarin.traditional: 湯姆試著用滅火器把火撲滅。
mandarin.english: Tom used a fire extinguisher to try and put the fire out.

cantonese.simplified: 你除咗钢琴之外仲有冇玩第啲乐器呀？
cantonese.traditional: 你除咗鋼琴之外仲有冇玩第啲樂器呀？
cantonese.english: Do you play any instruments other than the piano?

mandarin.simplified: 从那儿很容易就能看到焰火。
mandarin.traditional: 從那兒很容易就能看到焰火。
mandarin.english: It's easy to see the fireworks from over there.

cantonese.simplified: 你咁样衰，整容都冇用㗎喇。
cantonese.traditional: 你咁樣衰，整容都冇用㗎喇。

mandarin.traditional: 這本書他們讀起來夠簡單了。
mandarin.english: This book is easy enough for them to read.

cantonese.simplified: 个问答比赛简直易过借火。
cantonese.traditional: 個問答比賽簡直易過借火。
cantonese.english: The quiz competition was a piece of cake.

mandarin.simplified: 对不起，我们不接受信用卡。
mandarin.traditional: 對不起，我們不接受信用卡。
mandarin.english: Sorry, we don't accept credit cards.

cantonese.simplified: 你寄咗几多张圣诞卡俾人呀？
cantonese.traditional: 你寄咗幾多張聖誕卡俾人呀？
cantonese.english: How many Christmas cards did you send?

mandarin.simplified: 一名警探到达了犯罪现场。
mandarin.traditional: 一名警探到達了犯罪現場。
mandarin.english: A detective arrived upon the scene of the crime.

cantonese.simplified: 而家阿Tom得罪咗你啲咩唧？
cantonese.traditional: 而家阿Tom得罪咗你啲咩唧？
cantonese.english: Why do you hate Tom so much?

mandarin.simplified: 不要根据封面来判断一本书。
mandarin.traditional: 不要根據封面來判斷一本書。
mandarin.english: Don't judge a book by its cover.

cantonese.simplified: 个法官判咗佢坐一年监。
cantonese.traditional: 個法官判咗佢坐一年監。
cantonese.english: The judge sentenced him to one year's imprisonment.

mandarin.simplified: 今天，许多人担心失去工作。
mandarin.traditional: 今天，許多人擔心失去工作。
mandarin.english: Today, many people worry about losing their jobs.

cantonese.simplified: 佢搞到阿爸阿妈好担心。
cantonese.traditional: 佢搞到阿爸阿媽好擔心。
cantonese.english: He caused his parents a lot of anxiety.

mandarin.simplified: 他太太来自于加利福尼亚州。
mandarin.traditional: 他太太來自於加利福尼亞州。
mandarin.english: His wife comes from California.

cantonese.simplified: 听渠口音，一定系九州人嘞。
cantonese.traditional: 聽渠口音，一定係九州人嘞。
cantonese.english: Judging from his accent, he must be from Kyushu.

mandarin.simplified: 听讲座时，你应该保持安静。
mandarin.traditional: 聽講座時，你應該保持安靜。
mandarin.english: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.

cantonese.simplified: 我净系想自己静一阵啫。
cantonese.traditional: 我淨係想自己靜一陣啫。
cantonese.english: I just need some time alone.

mandarin.simplified: 他卖掉了他的事业并且退休。
mandarin.traditional: 他賣掉了他的事業並且退休。
mandarin.english: He sold his business and retired.

cantonese.simplified: 你应该谂吓你退休。
cantonese.traditional: 你應該諗嚇你退休。
cantonese.english: You should think about your retirement.

mandarin.simplified: 他既会打网球，又会打棒球。
mandarin.traditional: 他既會打網球，又會打棒球。
mandarin.english: He can play both tennis and baseball.

cantonese.simplified: 「既」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「既」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “既” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 她做了一件好看的衣服给我。
mandarin.traditional: 她做了一件好看的衣服給我。
mandarin.english: She made me a nice dress.

cantonese.simplified: 我喺我个衣柜度摷紧有冇衫可以捐出去做善事。
cantonese.traditional: 我喺我個衣櫃度摷緊有冇衫可以捐出去做善事。
cantonese.english: I'm going through my closet to find clothes to give to charity.

mandarin.simplified: 在您国家的人是吃米饭的吗？
mandarin.traditional: 在您國家的人是吃米飯的嗎？
mandarin.english: Do people in your country eat rice?

cantonese.simplified: 「您」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「您」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “您” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 你应该考虑他们的宗教。
mandarin.traditional: 你應該考慮他們的宗教。
mandarin.english: You should think of their religions.

cantonese.simplified: 「宗」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「宗」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “宗” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。
mandarin.traditional: 事故似乎和厚厚的積雪有關。
mandarin.english: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.

cantonese.simplified: 「积」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「積」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “積” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我感觉好像没有选择的余地。
mandarin.traditional: 我感覺好像沒有選擇的餘地。
mandarin.english: I felt like I had no choice.

cantonese.simplified: 重有进步嘅余地。
cantonese.traditional: 重有進步嘅餘地。
cantonese.english: There's room for improvement.

mandarin.simplified: 真相可能比谎言更令人痛苦。
mandarin.traditional: 真相可能比謊言更令人痛苦。
mandarin.english: The truth can be more painful than a lie.

cantonese.simplified: 我一行路，呢度就痛到好犀利。
cantonese.traditional: 我一行路，呢度就痛到好犀利。
cantonese.english: When I try to walk, I get an awful pain here.

mandarin.simplified: 你最近检查我们的补给了吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你最近檢查我們的補給了嗎？
mandarin.english: Have you checked our supplies recently?

cantonese.simplified: 有红色底线嗰啲字全部都要检查吓有冇串错。
cantonese.traditional: 有紅色底線嗰啲字全部都要檢查嚇有冇串錯。
cantonese.english: All the words underlined in red should be checked for spelling.

entries.english: to differ; different, wrong; nearly, almost; an officer

mandarin.simplified: 差不多是我们就寝的时间了。
mandarin.traditional: 差不多是我們就寢的時間了。
mandarin.english: It's about time we went to bed.

cantonese.simplified: 佢差唔多半夜嗰阵返到屋企。
cantonese.traditional: 佢差唔多半夜嗰陣返到屋企。
cantonese.english: He came home at almost midnight.

mandarin.simplified: 他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。
mandarin.traditional: 他在教學上擁有豐富的經驗。
mandarin.english: He has a lot of teaching experience.

cantonese.simplified: 出太阳嗰阵，就见到富士山㗎喇。
cantonese.traditional: 出太陽嗰陣，就見到富士山㗎喇。
cantonese.english: On a clear day, you can see Mt. Fuji.

mandarin.simplified: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
mandarin.traditional: 什麼是您最大的靈感來源？
mandarin.english: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

cantonese.simplified: 你写呢首歌嘅灵感喺边到嚟㗎？
cantonese.traditional: 你寫呢首歌嘅靈感喺邊到嚟㗎？
cantonese.english: What inspired you to write this song?

mandarin.simplified: 汤姆和玛丽达成了协议。
mandarin.traditional: 湯姆和瑪麗達成了協議。
mandarin.english: Tom and Mary came to an understanding.

cantonese.simplified: 你需唔需要我哋嘅协助？
cantonese.traditional: 你需唔需要我哋嘅協助？
cantonese.english: Do you need our assistance?

mandarin.simplified: 你最喜欢这本书中的哪个角色？
mandarin.traditional: 你最喜歡這本書中的哪個角色？
mandarin.english: Who's your favorite character in this book?

cantonese.simplified: 呢个只系问题嘅冰山一角。
cantonese.traditional: 呢個只係問題嘅冰山一角。
cantonese.english: This is just a symptom of a much bigger problem.

mandarin.simplified: 她告诉了他自己相信占星术。
mandarin.traditional: 她告訴了他自己相信占星術。
mandarin.english: She told him that she believed in astrology.

cantonese.simplified: 「占」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「佔」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “佔” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 这条领带跟我的西装不配。
mandarin.traditional: 這條領帶跟我的西裝不配。
mandarin.english: This tie doesn't go with my suit.

cantonese.simplified: 渠等真系绝配。
cantonese.traditional: 渠等真係絕配。
cantonese.english: They were the perfect match.

mandarin.simplified: 我会把它看作一个征兆。
mandarin.traditional: 我會把它看作一個徵兆。
mandarin.english: I'd take it as a sign.

cantonese.simplified: 好多人去应征。
cantonese.traditional: 好多人去應徵。
cantonese.english: A lot of people applied for the job.

mandarin.simplified: 你计划去大学后主修什么吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你計劃去大學後主修什麼嗎？
mandarin.english: What do you plan to major in at college?

cantonese.simplified: 我用咗一千円修理我架单车。
cantonese.traditional: 我用咗一千円修理我架單車。
cantonese.english: It cost me a thousand yen to get my bicycle fixed.

mandarin.simplified: 鲨鱼皮比金枪鱼皮粗糙多了。
mandarin.traditional: 鯊魚皮比金槍魚皮粗糙多了。
mandarin.english: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.

cantonese.simplified: 汤姆买六合彩赢咗一皮嘢。
cantonese.traditional: 湯姆買六合彩贏咗一皮嘢。
cantonese.english: Tom won $10,000 in the lottery.

mandarin.simplified: 汤姆在直升机上向玛丽挥手。
mandarin.traditional: 湯姆在直升機上向瑪麗揮手。
mandarin.english: Tom waved at Mary from the helicopter.

cantonese.simplified: 「挥」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「揮」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “揮” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 参观所有观光胜地累坏了我。
mandarin.traditional: 參觀所有觀光勝地累壞了我。
mandarin.english: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.

cantonese.simplified: 有人话真理必胜。
cantonese.traditional: 有人話真理必勝。
cantonese.english: It is said that truth always triumphs.

mandarin.simplified: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
mandarin.traditional: 夜幕降臨時，孩子們回家了。
mandarin.english: The children returned home at dusk.

cantonese.simplified: 听日佢会喺月球降落。
cantonese.traditional: 聽日佢會喺月球降落。
cantonese.english: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.

mandarin.simplified: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。
mandarin.traditional: 美國是一個自稱沒有社會階層的國家。
mandarin.english: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.

cantonese.simplified: 「阶」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「階」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “階” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 哪一位法官审理此案？
mandarin.traditional: 哪一位法官審理此案？
mandarin.english: Which judge heard the case?

cantonese.simplified: 「审」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「審」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “審” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我们发现这个男孩睡得很沉。
mandarin.traditional: 我們發現這個男孩睡得很沉。
mandarin.english: We found the boy fast asleep.

cantonese.simplified: 我呢排系噉发一个梦，我喺只沉紧嘅船上面，啲水系噉涌入嚟，我好腾鸡噉拎住个桶𢳂走啲水。
cantonese.traditional: 我呢排係噉發一個夢，我喺隻沉緊嘅船上面，啲水係噉湧入嚟，我好騰雞噉拎住個桶𢳂走啲水。
cantonese.english: I keep having this dream where I'm on a sinking ship, and I'm frantically using a bucket to try and bail out all the water that's flooding in.

mandarin.simplified: 我的父亲坚持要我们等火车。
mandarin.traditional: 我的父親堅持要我們等火車。
mandarin.english: My father insisted on our waiting for the train.

cantonese.simplified: 「坚」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「堅」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “堅” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 汤姆既彬彬有礼又善解人意。
mandarin.traditional: 湯姆既彬彬有禮又善解人意。
mandarin.english: Tom is polite and sensitive.

cantonese.simplified: 我喺我个衣柜度摷紧有冇衫可以捐出去做善事。
cantonese.traditional: 我喺我個衣櫃度摷緊有冇衫可以捐出去做善事。
cantonese.english: I'm going through my closet to find clothes to give to charity.

mandarin.simplified: 你和爸爸更亲还是妈妈更亲？
mandarin.traditional: 你和爸爸更親還是媽媽更親？
mandarin.english: Are you closer to your mother or to your father?

cantonese.simplified: 你应该同你阿爸阿妈倾吓先。
cantonese.traditional: 你應該同你阿爸阿媽傾嚇先。
cantonese.english: First of all, you should talk it over with your parents.

mandarin.simplified: 「刘」是什么意思？
mandarin.traditional: 「劉」是什麼意思？
mandarin.english: What does “刘” mean?

cantonese.simplified: 「刘」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「劉」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “劉” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 40%以上的学生去读大学。
mandarin.traditional: 40%以上的學生去讀大學。
mandarin.english: More than 40 percent of students go on to university.

cantonese.simplified: 佢哋识唔识读呢几只字呀？
cantonese.traditional: 佢哋識唔識讀呢幾隻字呀？
cantonese.english: Are they able to read these words?

mandarin.simplified: 看来今天会是漫长的一天啊。
mandarin.traditional: 看來今天會是漫長的一天啊。
mandarin.english: Looks like today will be a long day.

cantonese.simplified: 你知等阵会点㗎啦，系咪啊？
cantonese.traditional: 你知等陣會點㗎啦，係咪啊？
cantonese.english: You know what happens next, don't you?

mandarin.simplified: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。
mandarin.traditional: 他有超過一百萬美元的資產。
mandarin.english: He has over a million dollars in assets.

cantonese.simplified: 佢超速驾驶，俾差佬拉咗。
cantonese.traditional: 佢超速駕駛，俾差佬拉咗。
cantonese.english: The policeman arrested him for speeding.

mandarin.simplified: 你想要知道如何避免皱纹吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你想要知道如何避免皺紋嗎？
mandarin.english: Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?

cantonese.simplified: 圣诞假期间免费入场。
cantonese.traditional: 聖誕假期間免費入場。
cantonese.english: Admission is free during Christmas break.

mandarin.simplified: 我在压力之下工作表现最好。
mandarin.traditional: 我在壓力之下工作表現最好。
mandarin.english: I work best under pressure.

cantonese.simplified: 佢压抑唔到感情。
cantonese.traditional: 佢壓抑唔到感情。
cantonese.english: She couldn't suppress her emotions.

mandarin.simplified: 你知道银行什么时候关门吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你知道銀行什麼時候關門嗎？
mandarin.english: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?

cantonese.simplified: 唔好摆个银包喺个暖炉上面。
cantonese.traditional: 唔好擺個銀包喺個暖爐上面。
cantonese.english: Don't put the wallet on the top of the heater.

mandarin.simplified: 不言自明，金钱买不到幸福。
mandarin.traditional: 不言自明，金錢買不到幸福。
mandarin.english: It goes without saying that money can't buy happiness.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋买咩生日礼物俾佢好呀？
cantonese.traditional: 我哋買咩生日禮物俾佢好呀？
cantonese.english: What shall we buy him for his birthday?

mandarin.simplified: 公主向皇帝请求饶恕。
mandarin.traditional: 公主向皇帝請求饒恕。
mandarin.english: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.

cantonese.simplified: 「皇」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「皇」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “皇” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 你们该养成使用字典的习惯。
mandarin.traditional: 你們該養成使用字典的習慣。
mandarin.english: You should try to form the habit of using your dictionaries.

cantonese.simplified: 我哋养咗一只猫同埋一只狗。
cantonese.traditional: 我哋養咗一隻貓同埋一隻狗。
cantonese.english: We have a cat and a dog.

entries.english: third person pronoun; he, she, this, that

mandarin.simplified: 伊斯兰教大约在七世纪中传到中国。
mandarin.traditional: 伊斯蘭教大約在七世紀中傳到中國。
mandarin.english: Islam first reached China about the middle of the 7th century.

cantonese.simplified: 「伊」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「伊」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “伊” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
mandarin.traditional: 自我懷疑是聰明的第一標誌。
mandarin.english: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.

cantonese.simplified: 警察怀疑佢打劫咗间银行。
cantonese.traditional: 警察懷疑佢打劫咗間銀行。
cantonese.english: The police suspect that he robbed the bank.

entries.english: hold in hand; keep; carry out

mandarin.simplified: 我可以看看你的驾驶执照吗？
mandarin.traditional: 我可以看看你的駕駛執照嗎？
mandarin.english: May I see your driver's license?

cantonese.simplified: 佢执亲房都要打烂咁啲嘢先至安乐。
cantonese.traditional: 佢執親房都要打爛咁啲嘢先至安樂。
cantonese.english: She breaks something every time she cleans the room.

mandarin.simplified: 我需要一副好的太阳眼镜。
mandarin.traditional: 我需要一副好的太陽眼鏡。
mandarin.english: I need a good pair of sunglasses.

cantonese.simplified: 我喺度揾紧我副隐形眼镜。
cantonese.traditional: 我喺度揾緊我副隱形眼鏡。
cantonese.english: I'm looking for my contact lens.

mandarin.simplified: 去年有两百人因霍乱死亡。
mandarin.traditional: 去年有兩百人因霍亂死亡。
mandarin.english: Two hundred people died of cholera last year.

cantonese.simplified: 佢成日都捞乱糖同盐。
cantonese.traditional: 佢成日都撈亂糖同鹽。
cantonese.english: She frequently gets sugar and salt mixed up.

mandarin.simplified: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。
mandarin.traditional: 我抵抗不了甜食的誘惑。
mandarin.english: I can't resist sweet things.

cantonese.simplified: 列宁命令佢哋反抗。
cantonese.traditional: 列寧命令佢哋反抗。
cantonese.english: Lenin ordered them to rebel.

mandarin.simplified: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。
mandarin.traditional: 你每次都繼續犯同樣的錯誤。
mandarin.english: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.

cantonese.simplified: 他犯咗两次相同嘅错误。
cantonese.traditional: 他犯咗兩次相同嘅錯誤。
cantonese.english: He has made the same mistake twice.

mandarin.simplified: 我看见一只猫追着一只狗跑。
mandarin.traditional: 我看見一隻貓追着一隻狗跑。
mandarin.english: I see a cat chasing a dog.

cantonese.simplified: 你跑得几快都追唔上佢㗎喇。
cantonese.traditional: 你跑得幾快都追唔上佢㗎喇。
cantonese.english: No matter how fast you run, you won't catch up with him.

mandarin.simplified: 他给了我任何我需要的帮助。
mandarin.traditional: 他給了我任何我需要的幫助。
mandarin.english: He gave me whatever help I needed.

cantonese.simplified: 帮我用法文写封信得唔得啊？

mandarin.simplified: 人们指控他参与了这场阴谋。
mandarin.traditional: 人們指控他參與了這場陰謀。
mandarin.english: They accused him of being part of the plot.

cantonese.simplified: 佢唔知有人密谋刺杀佢。
cantonese.traditional: 佢唔知有人密謀刺殺佢。
cantonese.english: He was ignorant of the plot to assassinate him.

mandarin.simplified: 「宋」是什么意思？

mandarin.english: What does “宋” mean?

cantonese.english: What does “宋” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 你想要知道如何避免皱纹吗？
mandarin.traditional: 你想要知道如何避免皺紋嗎？

cantonese.simplified: 「避」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「避」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “避” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 他们会尽可能地抓更多的人。

mandarin.english: They would capture as many people as possible.

cantonese.simplified: 「抓」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「抓」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “抓” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 他光荣地从哈佛大学毕业了。
mandarin.traditional: 他光榮地從哈佛大學畢業了。
mandarin.english: He graduated from Harvard University with honors.

cantonese.simplified: 你老窦系咪令你好光荣？
cantonese.traditional: 你老竇係咪令你好光榮？
cantonese.english: Are you proud of your father?

mandarin.simplified: 在面包房工作的姑娘很可爱。
mandarin.traditional: 在麪包房工作的姑娘很可愛。
mandarin.english: The girl who works at the bakery is cute.

cantonese.simplified: 「姑」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「姑」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “姑” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 我的孙子还是个婴儿。
mandarin.traditional: 我的孫子還是個嬰兒。
mandarin.english: My grandson is still a baby.

cantonese.simplified: 「孙」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「孫」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “孫” mean?

mandarin.simplified: 他寻找一切可能的逃生途径。
mandarin.traditional: 他尋找一切可能的逃生途徑。
mandarin.english: He looked for every possible means of escape.

cantonese.simplified: 「逃」即系咩意思？
cantonese.traditional: 「逃」即係咩意思？
cantonese.english: What does “逃” mean?

mandarin.traditional: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了幾顆牙。
mandarin.english: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.

cantonese.simplified: 佢喺条管度擳咗啲牙膏出嚟。
cantonese.traditional: 佢喺條管度擳咗啲牙膏出嚟。
cantonese.english: He squeezed the toothpaste out of a tube.

mandarin.simplified: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。
mandarin.traditional: 你該結束這種愚蠢的行為了。
mandarin.english: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.

cantonese.simplified: 同法国嘅战争已经结束。
cantonese.traditional: 同法國嘅戰爭已經結束。
cantonese.english: The war with France was over.

mandarin.simplified: 小女孩害怕从屋顶上跳下来。
mandarin.traditional: 小女孩害怕從屋頂上跳下來。
mandarin.english: The girl was afraid to jump down from the roof.

cantonese.simplified: 边有咁大只蛤乸随街跳呀？
cantonese.traditional: 邊有咁大隻蛤乸隨街跳呀？
cantonese.english: That's too good to be true.

entries.english: top, summit, peak; to carry on the head

mandarin.simplified: 你不应该对你父母那样顶嘴。

mandarin.english: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.

cantonese.simplified: 咁热，戴返顶帽先好出街呀。
cantonese.traditional: 咁熱，戴返頂帽先好出街呀。
cantonese.english: Don't go out in this heat without wearing a hat.
